title: Priority encoder
summary: A priority encoder converts a one-hot (or multi-hot) input to a binary code, giving priority to the highest-numbered active input. Used in interrupt controllers (highest priority interrupt), CAM (highest-priority match), and arbiters. If multiple inputs are active, the highest-numbered (or lowest, depending on design) is encoded.

structure.meaning: Outputs the binary code of the highest active input. E.g., inputs 1010 -> output 11 (input 3 has highest priority).
Outputs the binary code of the highest active input among 8.
1 if any input is active (at least one 1).
Highest number = highest priority (or lowest, depending on design).

notes: Priority encoders are used in interrupt controllers (highest priority interrupt wins).
CAM uses priority encoders to select the highest-priority match.
Arbiters use priority encoders to grant access to the highest-priority requester.
A priority encoder can be built from a tree of 2:1 MUXes.
